baselineRelationship: Fresh baseline from merged PR3232. Earlier reader behavior retained; nine nullable directives removed during integration. Historical medians were not reused for acceptance.
hostSettings: Apple M4, ten heterogeneous cores, 24GiB RAM, AC low-power off, normal priority, no affinity, concurrent workstation GC; shared lock serializes cooperating heavy workloads, without claiming a quiet host.
packageLicenseEvidence: excel-tabular-data-2026-11-02.json; exact comparison versions unchanged, benchmark projects only

measurement.order: ABBA/BAAB alternating and case order rotated; two isolated contexts; one delegate call per whole operation. Same harness, input and dependency bytes; only OfficeIMO.Excel.dll differs.
measurement.allocation: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true), all threads, per operation. Owned strings are included.
measurement.validation: Every field and header checked for all six lanes in setup; every timed operation checks row count and a checksum over every field.
measurement.outliers: All blocks retained. Round sample averages its two lane blocks; series median uses twelve round samples. Aggregate is the median of twenty-four round samples, not a median of series medians.
measurement.reproduction: Build the embedded runner project under the heavy-run lock; invoke PairedProbe <baseline-directory> <candidate-directory> true/false with OFFICEIMO_EXCEL_GENERATED_INPUT pointing to the pinned corpus.

paired-v2-ascii-1.protocol: Two isolated assembly contexts, identical validated workload and harness; sequentialABBA/BAAB blocks,rotatedcaseorder,nooutlierremoval. Per-lane round sample is mean of its two8operation blocks. Reflection/delegate binding and full-field preflight outside timing. One delegate call per complete operation, no per-cell adapter. GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes precise includes all threads. No concurrent engine work.

acceptance.selectedMetric: At least 20 percent TOTAL end-to-end owned-string XLSX read allocation reduction for the escaped-name shape. Plain ASCII is a separate control.
acceptance.asciiAllocationFloor: About 2.32MB of baseline 2.396MB is required final unique strings. No claim of another 20 percent plain-ASCII allocation or latency gain.
acceptance.asciiTradeoff: Raw median +2.28percent; typed +0.44percent; allocations effectively unchanged. Unchanged peer aggregate timing varies up to2.84 percent. No statistical equivalence or portable ranking claim.

reviews.originalReview: P2 escaped namespace URI identity; otherwise no findings
reviews.targetedConfirmation: No remaining issue; root/default/general attrs, row prefixes, repeated row qualification, noncompact cells inspected

profiles.interpretation: Sampled thread-time phase locations include waits and propagated logical benchmark stacks. They are not exclusive CPU budgets or isolated inflation throughput; no worker percentage is used as evidence. Traces include setup and warmups. Native inflation is unchanged.

entity-baseline-allocations.methodology: Sampled GC allocation ticks over the entire diagnostic process, including startup, setup and warmups; weights are sampled byte amounts, not exact per-type operation totals.

entity-v2-allocations.methodology: Sampled GC allocation ticks over the entire diagnostic process, including startup, setup and warmups; weights are sampled byte amounts, not exact per-type operation totals.

collector.entityOptions: Attach to one benchmark child, 40-second maximum, 32MiB event buffer, 2 warmups, 4 measurements, 128 invocations, outliers retained; separate CPU-only and GC-verbose runs.

experiments.unqualifiedReason: First entity candidate admitted escaped namespace declarations without normalized URI identity. Large reader-boundary control reproduced missing XmlException; final candidate restores full XmlReader validation for escaped attribute values.

limits: net472 cross-build only; no Windows/PowerShell5.1 execution.
Numeric entity references, unknown/truncated names, Unicode and literal CR retain prior decoding/validation fallbacks.
No new native inflater, worker scheduler or resource/peak-memory claim.
No runtime changes to CSV, binary formats, writers, cell/range/formatting or grid loader; their earlier comparison cohorts remain separate.
Only XLSX performance acceptance rerun here; XLSB/XLS escaped-profile preflight validates the new benchmark parameter.
NativeAOT osx-arm64 and actual WASM under Node qualified; ordinary net8.0 runtime tests not rerun.
